rest_pose_offsets.interpretation: rest-relative features should be zero; calibrated absolute elbow bend intentionally retains the rig's geometric rest bend so source and target are compared from the same straight-arm zero

coordinate_frames.previous: source torso/forearm rest frames mapped onto Waluigi bone-local rest frames; elbow is an unsigned geometric angle; forearm roll assumes local +Y for both forearm branches
coordinate_frames.calibrated: body basis from labeled left/right shoulder axis and torso-up; forearm basis from elbow-to-wrist axis and projected body-forward; forearm twist extracted around each branch's rest-local distal anatomical axis; elbow is absolute bend angle from straight (not a rig-specific rest-angle delta)

left_right_mirror_convention.forearm_roll: sign evaluated around each side's elbow-to-wrist distal axis

limitations: The calibration dataset contains left-arm profile bones only; Waluigi right-side motion is inferred by the validated mirror map, not measured directly from raw ANM.
Semantic interval overlap is not a retarget-quality guarantee; temporal sequence coverage and pose coherence remain separate gates.
